brief:
Settlers attacked a water transmission line serving the Palestinian communities of Yarza and al-Ras al-Ahmar, Shehab Wire reported. The assault targeted critical infrastructure in the areas, disrupting water supply to residents.

The incident marks the latest in a pattern of settler violence against Palestinian water systems in the occupied West Bank. Palestinian communities in the region depend heavily on functioning water networks to meet basic civilian needs. Details regarding the extent of damage to the pipeline and any repairs required remain unclear.
